channel.title: Pain001 for regulated teams: supported channel, private profiles, integration help
channel.description: The core stays free and permissively licensed. For teams that need a throat to choke: a supported release channel with an LTS line, private derivation of your bank's usage guideline into a validated profile, and integration recipes for your ERP or TMS. No prices on this page; one form.
